# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Senior Architect Personal Website

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for brand-first UX, composition rules, accessibility, and motion before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Defaults applied** (non-interactive): Depth=Standard; Audience=PR reviewer; Focus=UX composition + Accessibility/motion

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are first-viewport allowed vs disallowed elements enumerated without relying on implied “clean design” language? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every primary nav destination (Home, Work, About, Writing, Contact) including empty Writing state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are case study section requirements complete for context, challenge, constraints, approach, decisions, outcomes, and role? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are contact requirements specified for both primary path and fallback channel, including failure messaging? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are SEO/document metadata requirements present for unique titles and descriptions per route? [Gap, Contracts §SEO]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “hero-level” brand dominance defined in measurable/compositional terms rather than subjective prominence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Constitution II]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “curated” Selected Work quantified with an explicit count range for v1? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “designed (not merely stacked)” mobile layout clarified with testable expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Are reduced-motion requirements explicit about which motion classes are essential vs discretionary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Plan Decision 4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “comfortable reading” for long-form prose quantified enough to guide typography decisions (measure, hierarchy)? [Clarity, Spec §US4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do home composition rules in FR-001/FR-015 align with Constitution III (Composition Over Clutter) without conflict? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 Are card prohibitions consistent between hero (forbidden) and work index (list items allowed) without ambiguous “card” language? [Consistency, Constitution III, Plan structure]
- [ ] CHK013 Do Contact acceptance scenarios align with functional requirements for success feedback and response timing? [Consistency, Spec §US5, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Is terminology consistent for Writing vs Talks vs Notes across spec, plan, and IA contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Contracts IA]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001 (5-second brand recognition) be objectively assessed with the stated reviewer method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-003 (first-viewport element audit) be checked against an explicit allowlist? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK017 Are keyboard and reduced-motion success criteria tied to concrete, observable behaviors? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-006 (“above average personal site”) sufficiently structured despite subjective craft judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for missing case study imagery (typographic fallback)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for contact delivery failure with recoverable UX? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for unknown deep links / 404 recovery paths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for zero published writing entries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK023 Are slow-network / deferred imagery requirements specified for hero CTA priority? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements (A11y, Performance, Motion)

- [ ] CHK024 Are WCAG 2.2 AA intent requirements scoped to concrete concerns (keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced-motion)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, Constitution IV]
- [ ] CHK025 Are performance expectations in the plan measurable against constitution “immediate” hero feel language? [Clarity, Plan Performance Goals, Constitution IV]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the three intentional motions named and mapped so requirements do not invite decorative animation creep? [Completeness, Plan Decision 4, Constitution IV]
- [ ] CHK027 Are skip-to-content and focus-visibility requirements explicit for all primary interactive controls? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §US6]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption of file-based content (no CMS/auth) documented and consistent with plan simplicity gates? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK029 Are contact-form vendor/env dependencies documented as implementation concerns without leaving UX requirements vague? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions, Plan Decision 5]
- [ ] CHK030 Is analytics-off-by-default assumption reflected so privacy requirements are not accidentally implied as mandatory tracking? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Does “optional portrait” on About conflict with “real visual anchor” constitution guidance for imagery? [Ambiguity, Constitution Design Standards, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK032 Is engagement-type scope language (advisory/reviews/full-time) required content or optional copy? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK033 Are résumé download requirements clear when the PDF asset is absent (hide vs error)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Data Model]

## Notes

- Focus: UX composition + accessibility/motion (standard depth)
- Items left unchecked for reviewer ownership; `/speckit-implement` treats unchecked custom checklists as a gate
